summary: Practise safer records handling, cyber incident escalation and service continuity. Explore the five-day course outline and enrol.
lede: Cybersecurity in public administration helps service staff protect information and routine digital workflows. It is designed for records officers, service supervisors and procurement staff who need practical safeguards in everyday administrative work. Participants map sensitive information and workflow risks, strengthen account and device practices, recognize phishing, and practise incident escalation and continuity planning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for public-service professionals who handle records, accounts, digital services or administrative decisions and need to apply practical cybersecurity safeguards within their responsibilities.
modules: Public-Service Cyber Threats and NIST CSF
prerequisites: Familiarity with public-service administrative workflows or records handling is useful. The exercises require no coding, specialist cybersecurity software or access to live systems.
